item.title: 7 Biblical Truths to Remember When You Doubt God
item.description: Navigate seasons of doubt by embracing seven biblical truths that reaffirm God's unwavering presence, goodness, and immeasurable love for you. Discover how to find hope and peace, even amidst life's challenges, by holding onto God's promises and His profound plans for your future.

item.title: March 2026 Scripture Writing Challenge
item.description: Scripture writing plans are simple yet effective for helping us read, interpret, and absorb the Word of God. Rather than simply letting our eyes pass over a verse and perhaps miss its full meaning, writing Scripture helps us absorb each word and think through the full context of the passage. Click the Download button below to access your challenge!

item.title: 6 Prayers for the Woman Who Feels Alone
item.description: When you feel unwanted, abandoned, or invisible, prayer becomes your lifeline. These six powerful prayers remind you that God sees you, loves you, and has never left your side.Photo credit: SWN Canva

item.title: A Prayer to Surrender Myself to God - Your Daily Prayer - March 6
item.description: We say we love Jesus, but have we truly given Him everything? Discover what it means to stop holding back and surrender your whole life to the One who gave His for you.
